summary.intent: Fix the memory loop TUI injection tab so it tests against all active memories and shows clear inject/skip status instead of raw scores. Then remove the skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: The injection tab was updated to use PreviewSelection instead of SelectRelevant, showing INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons instead of raw scores. Two new tests were added and all 22 TUI tests passed. The command removal was planned but not yet executed.

repo: PreviewSelection returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped fields, while SelectRelevant only returns matched memories — use PreviewSelection for full coverage.
SelectRelevant filters to StatusActive only; PreviewSelection provides the complete picture including skip reasons like 'not active', 'scope mismatch', 'low strength'.
explanatory_insights.go is a hook handler, not a command — it must be preserved even when removing the insights command.
skilldb, skilltui, permissions, and insights directories exist as separate packages under cmd/entire/cli.
The memorylooptui package has a tab_injection.go, messages.go, root.go, and render_test.go as core files.

code.finding: testPromptResultMsg was changed to carry a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches.
Updated to call PreviewSelection() instead of SelectRelevant() to populate testPromptResultMsg.
View updated to show INJECT/SKIP labels with reasons and a summary line; raw score display removed.
unusedwrite lint fired because tests set activeTab but only called injectionTab.view() directly — fixed by removing unused field assignments.

workflow: When a test assertion substring matches an unintended string (e.g., 'INJECT' found inside 'RECENT INJECTIONS'), tighten the assertion rather than broadening the test.
Run lint after each substantive change; unusedwrite and other static analysis issues surface quickly and are cheap to fix inline.

friction: ExitPlanMode was called multiple times due to user interruptions during plan writing, requiring re-entry and re-writing of the plan.
The empty-state test initially passed spuriously because 'INJECT' appeared as a substring of 'RECENT INJECTIONS' in the rendered output, requiring assertion refinement.
unusedwrite lint warning fired on test field assignments that were not caught until the explicit lint check step.
open_items: Removal of skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands and related code — plan was written but implementation was not executed in this session.
Need to verify which shared helpers (refreshCacheIfStale, metadataToSessionRow, backfillSummaries, backfillFacets) are used by the commands being removed vs. those being kept.
